title: Operator Concierge Docket and Stability Protocols — Nov 2025 (scratchpad)
body:
Purpose:
This is a compact operator-facing docket for an upcoming mini-launch window (target week 2025-11-16). Focus: a small feature bundle with model routing adjustments + KV cache heuristics. Behavior: keep the site steady, surface regressions quickly, and allow safe backout with minimal blast radius.

Audience and intent:
- Primary: on-call operators, deployment lead, SRE liaison.
- Secondary: release owner and product PM for rollback decisions.
- Tone: quick-reference, first-responder cues, and postmortem seed notes.

High-level timeline (compact):
- T-72h (Mon 2025-11-10): final smoke checklist; owner: Dana. Ensure canary capacity reserved in eu-west-1; tag 2x hosts as watch-only.
- T-48h (Wed 2025-11-12): dry-run: apply config to staging, run synthetic traffic for 2h (95th p99 latency target within 15% of baseline). Owner: Ravi.
- T-24h (Thu 2025-11-13): freeze deploys to dependent subsystems; telemetries baked; ops roster confirmed. Owner: Maya.
- T-0 (Mon 2025-11-16 09:00 UTC): canary open at 1% traffic for 30m, if green move to 10% for 60m, if green steady ramp to 50% over 2h using step schedule.
- T+4h: post-rollout smoke and regression probe set. Owner: rotation pair.

Quick preflight checklist (T-72 -> T-24):
- Confirm canary capacity + reserved GPUs: compute pool eu-west-1-dedicated (confirm node count and autoscale limits).
- Validate model variant compatibility matrix (routing table) and fallback mapping.
- Sanity-run smoke prompts (sample prompt set: ./ops/smokes/minilaunch-sample-2025-11.txt).
- Verify KMS access and audit log ingestion for private deployments.
- Confirm rollback images are pre-baked and accessible from registry (images tagged: release-2025-11-16-rollback).
- Pager/Slack rotations: #oncall-ops copy, escalation list updated.

Operator concierge quick cues (first 15 minutes of canary):
- If p50 latency > baseline + 30% OR p99 > baseline + 40% => pause ramp, notify release owner and SRE.
- If error rate (4xx/5xx) increases by >3x baseline OR absolute >0.5% requests => immediate pause + small rollback to previous model variant.
- If memory OOMs/ GPU OOMs seen on >1 host => immediate throttle canary to 0% and open P1 incident.
- If KV hit ratio drops by >20% and latency increases => check cache warming job; consider temporary route to warm cache-only nodes.

Annotated fallback matrix (compact):
- Route mismatch or model crash: fallback -> stable-1 (cpu-quantized) in same region.
- Capacity pressure: fallback -> hosted-fallback-region (us-east-1) with cross-region tag.
- Cost spike due to unexpected token count: throttling policy -> cap max_tokens per request (temporary) + notify product.

Telemetry guardrails and sample thresholds (notes to operator):
- Signals to watch live: p50, p95, p99 latency; 4xx/5xx rates; CPU/GPU utilization; queue length; KV cache hit ratio; token-per-request distribution histogram.
- Canary success rule: no signal crossing defined thresholds for 90 consecutive minutes.
- Alert playbooks: link to alert runbooks in Confluence above. Keep a 15-minute watch after each traffic step.

Smoke test commands (ops snippet):
- curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_KEY' -d @smoke-request.json https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate | jq '.latency'
- run ./ops/loadgen/run-smoke.sh --profile=minilaunch --duration=15m --concurrency=8
- check logs: k get pods -l app=serving-runtime -o wide; kubectl logs -l release=canary | tail -n 200

Operator rotation & contacts (compact):
- Day-ops lead (09:00-17:00 UTC): Dana Li (owner).
- Evening watch (17:00-01:00 UTC): Ravi Patel.
- Night fallback (01:00-09:00 UTC): Ethan Park.
- SRE escalation: sres@redwood.com, Pager: ENG-SRE-PAGER.
- Product/PM: Laura Chen (pm@redwood.ai) for user-impact decisions.

Decision ladder and criteria (for canary hold/abort):
- Hold: any threshold crossing per above. Hold for 30m, investigate, then either resume or rollback. Log investigation notes in JIRA RE-2148.
- Abort: systemic failures (OOM across >2 hosts, persistent 5xx >1% across 60m, or data corruption). If abort, trigger rollback to stable image and notify exec channel (#release-alerts).
- Soft rollback option: route 50% traffic back to stable variant while keeping 50% on canary for faster forensics (only for partial regressions).

Post-rollout checks (T+4h -> T+72h):
- Run regression prompt set and diff with baseline outputs. Capture hallucination/regression metrics.
- Cost delta analysis: track token counts and GPU-hours vs last week; target <10% increase.
- User-facing errors & CS tickets: tally errors reported to support; bridge call if >3 customer tickets referencing same issue.
- Schedule quick 15m retro with operators and release owner within 24h; add notes to RE-2148.

Known unknowns / open questions (notes to self):
- We have intermittent KV warm-up script failures on rolling restarts (investigate run id pattern).
- Need a playbook for partial-eval rollback (how to route traffic gracefully between model variants without flapping).
- Confirm whether the dedicated pool autoscaler will respect lower-priority burst slots during canary (action: ask infra team).

Micronarrative — potential failure scenario + comm ladder (copy into incident binder):
- 09:20 UTC: p99 spikes to 2x baseline and KV hit ratio drops 30% -> operator pauses ramp at 1% and posts summary to #release-ops.
- 09:24 UTC: SRE runs top profiling; sees KV eviction thrash on canary nodes.
- 09:35 UTC: decision: soft rollback to stable-1 (50% split) to reduce user impact while debugging.
- 09:50 UTC: tickets opened in JIRA (RE-2148), product notified, exec channel briefed.
- Postmortem: root cause KV policy mismatch + cache resizing not propagated to canary. Action items assigned.

Postmortem seed template (to paste in JIRA):
- Summary: one-line description.
- Timeline: minute-level events.
- Impact: requests affected, user-visible issues, cost delta.
- Root cause analysis: hypotheses and evidence.
- Remediation: short-term and long-term fixes with owners.
- Learnings and guardrail adjustments.

Misc notes and housekeeping:
- Add this docket to weekly release sync and pin to the top of the meeting.
- Remind infra to tag rollback images with immutable manifest digests.
- Consider a small canary-only KV pre-warm job in next sprint.
- TODO: convert smoke sample set into canonical dataset in ./ops/benchmarks/ for reproducibility.

End of scratchpad.

(Notes-to-self format: this is intentionally terse; keep operator-facing cues front-and-center. Save cleaned version to Confluence when stable — label: MINILAUNCH-2025-11.)
